name: Custom Shape Garden Metal Sign With Stake
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from durable metal steel, offering a strong, weather-resistant, and long-lasting outdoor display finish.
    - Made from 1mm thick steel, providing a sturdy structure while maintaining a clean and elegant decorative look.
    - Includes a matching metal stake for stable placement in gardens, yards, lawns, flower beds, or outdoor pathways.
    - Comes with bolt and nut hardware for secure attachment between the sign and the stake.
    - Designed for both decorative and practical outdoor use, with a solid construction suitable for long-term display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
            +) Metal Sign size 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm with Stake size 2 x 8 in ~ 5.08 x 20.32 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm with Stake size 3 x 10 in ~ 7.62 x 25.4 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm with Stake size 4 x 12 in ~ 10.16 x 30.48 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 14 x 14 in ~ 35.56 x 35.56 cm with Stake size 5 x 14 in ~ 12.7 x 35.56 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 16 x 16 in ~ 40.64 x 40.64 cm with Stake size 5 x 16 in ~ 12.7 x 40.64 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 18 x 18 in ~ 45.72 x 45.72 cm with Stake size 6 x 18 in ~ 15.24 x 45.72 cm
            +) Metal Sign size 24 x 24 in ~60.96 x 60.96 cm with Stake size 8 x 24 in ~20.32 x 60.96 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports both print on one side and print on both sides, depending on the selected design.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized garden sign and an outdoor decorative yard accent.
    - Designed to be installed easily in soil, lawns, flower beds, planters, or garden pathways using the included metal stake.
    - Suitable for gardens, front yards, backyards, farms, patios, and outdoor decorative spaces.
    - The sturdy metal construction helps the sign remain stable and attractive in outdoor settings.
    - Perfect for adding a personalized and eye-catching touch to any landscape or outdoor area.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, neighbors, gardeners, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, housewarmings, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, memorial occasions, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for garden lovers, outdoor décor lovers, hobby enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys personalized yard art.
    - A thoughtful gift for farms, gardens, patios, and outdoor living spaces.
    - Great for commemorative displays, seasonal decoration, and unique personalized keepsakes.
    - Adds a rustic, personal, and decorative touch to any outdoor space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Garden Metal Sign With Stake

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
